name: alfred-map
description: Routes and place search on a live map in Alfred 6: car, transit, bike and walk, open data or HERE
author: izsk

scripts.build: bun build src/main.ts --target=node --format=esm --minify-syntax --outfile workflow/bin/zmap.mjs && bun scripts/build-workflow.ts
scripts.check: bun run typecheck && bun run lint && bun run fmt:check && bun run test
